item.title: Active Maoists in Odisha drop to single digits: Anti-Naxal ADG
item.description: In a significant breakthrough in Maoist operations in Odisha, Anti-Naxal Additional Director General (ADG) Sanjeeb Panda, on Tuesday, announced that the number of active Maoists in the state has now reduced to single digits following the surrender of top Maoist Sukru. According to the ADG of Anti-Naxal Operations, Sukru has surrendered before the Kandhamal police, marking a major success for security forces. item.title: 2 tuskers from neighbouring Jharkhand wreak havoc in Odisha villages
item.description: Panic gripped the residents of Nilagiri block in Balasore district after two tuskers from neighbouring Jharkhand created havoc in the region. Descending from Swarnachuda Hill last night, the adult elephants entered Gangapura village and nearby areas on Tuesday, causing widespread damage.
